description: Official pay statistics for one job in one place: median, 10th to 90th percentiles, employment, the publisher and reference period, take-home pay where the site shows it, and for US states and metro areas the U.S. Department of Labor's four wage levels (entry to fully competent). Covers the US (national, every state, the 50 largest metro areas), Canada (national, provinces) and the UK (national; regions are a table on the national answer). Returns the page's Markdown copy with a citation line.

job.description: Job title as people say it (registered nurse, software engineer), a FedSalary page slug (registered-nurses) or an occupation code (SOC 29-1141, NOC 31301).

place.description: us, ca or uk for a whole country (default us); a US state (texas or TX); a large US metro area (austin, seattle); a Canadian province (ontario); a UK region (london).

name: get_pay
title: Official pay for a job
